customManagers.description: actionlint: ci.yml pins the download-actionlint.bash script to a commit SHA of rhysd/actionlint itself, then passes the actionlint version to download as a separate argument - keep both in lockstep.

gitleaks CLI, downloaded and checksum-verified directly from GitHub Releases in ci.yml (not the gitleaks-action wrapper) via a GITLEAKS_VERSION env var - matching that one declaration keeps every other reference to the version in the same step (interpolated from the env var) in sync automatically.
zizmor, installed from PyPI with an exact pinned version in ci.yml.
Syft, installed and run directly (not via anchore/sbom-action) in both supply-chain.yml and release.yml via a shared SYFT_VERSION env var - keep both files in sync.

packageRules.description: Batch every uses:/container digest bump (including plain re-pins where only the SHA changed, not the version) into one weekly PR instead of one per action - this repo already reviews and merges them together.
Batch the workflow-embedded tool version bumps (actionlint, gitleaks, zizmor, Syft) into their own single weekly PR, separate from the github actions group above.
